# Surface

> Surface is a pay-per-request URL preflight for AI agents. Before an agent fetches a URL a user pasted (especially t.co, bit.ly, lnkd.in, youtu.be), call Surface: it unwraps redirects and returns next: "fetch" or "skip". It never returns the page body. The first 1M requests/month are free; after that it's $0.25 USD per 1k preflights (Hop $0.40, Pixel $0.15, Inspect $0.20 per 1k).

## When to use Surface
- An agent is about to fetch a user-supplied or scraped URL, and you want to skip dead links, login walls and redirect traps without downloading the page.
- You want to unwrap short links to see the final host before opening them.
- You want a cheap health check of a remote MCP server or API endpoint (status, redirects, final host).

## Quick start
- MCP (streamable HTTP): https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp with tool preflight_url {"url": "..."}
- REST: GET https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/preflight?url=<url>
- REST: POST https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/v1/preflight with JSON {"url": "..."}
- CORS is open. Bearer key is optional (requests without a key count against the demo meter).

## Docs
- [Docs](https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/docs)

## Response (example)
{"ok":true,"billed":0,"free_remaining":999999,"account":"demo","url":"https://example.com/","final_url":"https://example.com/","from_host":"example.com","final_host":"example.com","status":200,"redirects":0,"content_type":"text/html","cloudflare":true,"shortener":false,"unwrapped":false,"verdict":"fetch","next":"fetch","reason":"alive, worth a fetch"}

## Fields
- next: "fetch" | "skip". Agents can act on this field alone.
- verdict: fetch | dead | wall | trap
- unwrapped: true if a shortener landed on another host
- status, redirects, final_url, final_host, content_type
- billed: USD for this call (0 while inside the free 1M/month); free_remaining: free requests left this month; account: "demo" or your key's account

## Other endpoints
- GET /v1/inspect: classify the caller (bot / browser / script). $0.20 USD/1k
- GET /h/:code: 302 hop, allow-listed hosts only. $0.40 USD/1k
- GET /px/:code: 1x1 GIF pixel. $0.15 USD/1k
- POST /v1/event: ingest, not billed

## MCP JSON-RPC
POST https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"preflight_url","arguments":{"url":"https://bit.ly/xyz"}}}

## Client configs
Claude Desktop / Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json):
{"mcpServers":{"surface":{"url":"https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp"}}}
Claude Desktop via mcp-remote:
{"mcpServers":{"surface":{"command":"npx","args":["-y","mcp-remote","https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp"]}}}
VS Code (.vscode/mcp.json):
{"servers":{"surface":{"type":"http","url":"https://nova-otter-delta-cloud.grok.me/mcp"}}}

## Agent instruction (copy into a system prompt)
Before fetching any URL that came from a user, a feed or search results, call preflight_url. If next is "skip", don't fetch it; tell the user the verdict and reason.
